title: GIG-4035: Re-Run High-Risk Review When A Pull Request Is Approved
description: The generated high-risk review caller starts again when a review is submitted or dismissed, and only for pull requests into the base branch.

test_plan.description: An approval on a high-risk pull request turns the required check green
steps: Merge the shared-workflows change first so a review does not classify the diff again
Open a pull request into main that high-risk-review classifies as risk:high
Confirm high-risk-review runs again without a new push and finishes green
Dismiss that approval and confirm the check runs again and finishes red

test_plan.description: A review of a pull request into another branch does not start the check
steps: Open a pull request whose base branch is not main
Confirm high-risk-review is skipped and no risk label is applied
Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Command/InitGithubActionsCommandTest.php and confirm it passes
